newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZU MOST ACTIVE ON BOURSE CENTRAL MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BIRZU MOST ACTIVE ON BOURSE CENTRAL MARKET.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzu Dairy shares were traded most actively on the central market of the Vilnius bourse last week with turnover of 584,865 litas, the stock exchange said on Monday.
It was followed by Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company with trade of 358,709 litas, the bourse said in a statement.
The most active stock in bloc trades was Vilniaus Vingis which registered business of 3.37 million litas last week.
Ukio Bank saw shares worth 1.93 million litas change hands last week in bloc trades, it added.
